messages:
maya: Quick follow-up on the proxy throttle contract RFC — we need to settle where abuse signals are interpreted (edge gateway vs admission) and what backpressure we surface to clients. Decision needed for this week's rollout.

jonathan: I think short-term enforcement at the gateway (fast failure) + interpret signals at admission for longer-term penalties. Gateway -> fast reject + credit_hint; admission -> scoring + soft-evict.

sam: telemetry concern: gateways don't have full model cost context. If we expose a single `credit_hint` signal, we avoid leaking internal cost calc.

maya: agreed. can we standardize the `credit_hint` payload? e.g., {unit: \"token\", cost_est: 12, urgency: \"low\"}

lia: careful about exposing cost_est to clients. prefer enum buckets: `low|med|high` so SDKs can adapt without exact numbers.

jonathan: +1 to buckets. also need a deterministic fallback map for model degrade: gateway -> small-model v1 -> small-model v0 -> reject.

derek: abuse detector will need early visibility. propose a mirrored async stream from gateway to abuse-service with a tunable sample rate. doesn't need to block admission.

sam: sampling rate should be adaptive by tenant risk score. high-risk => 100% mirror. low-risk => 0.1%. also add a small-rate burst window to catch spikes.

maya: can we codify policy like below?

```throttle_policy:\n  enforcement_point: gateway\n  exposed_signal: credit_bucket    # enum: low,med,high\n  mirror_stream: abuse_events://ingest\n  fallback_sequence:\n    - model: redwood-small-v1\n    - model: redwood-small-v0\n    - action: reject\n```

jonathan: ops and telemetry need schema v1 by EOD. sam can you take schema owner?

sam: on it. will post proto + examples in #eng-telemetry and link here.

ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: throttle-proxy v4 -> canary in prod at 03:30 UTC :gear:

lia: rollout checklist — canary metric gates: p95 latency <= 120ms, error_rate < 0.5%, degraded_model_accuracy delta <= 1.5%

maya: thanks. action items: sam proto, jonathan admission adapters, derek mirror consumer. We'll sync tomorrow. :thumbsup:
notes: short thread, RFC follow-up on abuse signal placement and gateway/admission responsibilities. includes proto + rollout cadence.
